name: 53719 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53719 (Madison) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53719 (Madison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53719 (Madison) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
